The KOI API (v3) accepts THREE identification modes — pass ONE of: (1) booking_id + name, (2) reference + name, or (3) booking_id + reference + name (in mode 3 the API uses booking_id and ignores reference). NAME and REFERENCE matching are case-insensitive, but the name must have NO whitespace variations from the booking (e.g. double-spaces, leading/trailing spaces are rejected with 400 'Name does not match'). ALWAYS pass: name (string, e.g. \"Henry Taylor\") and type (string: RECONFIRMATION | DRIVER_DETAILS | PICKUP_INSTRUCTIONS | LOST_ITEM | CALLBACK_REQUEST). PASS at least ONE of: booking_id (string, e.g. \"597596\") OR reference (string, e.g. \"REF-BIZ-0I9PONUE\"). Optional: itemCritical (bool, default false — Intent 12 ALWAYS uses false; the agent shares driver details first then offers escalation), complaintReason (string, only for CALLBACK_REQUEST; name not required for CALLBACK_REQUEST). Bookings outside a ±3-day window from today, name mismatches, and unknown booking IDs all return
